I'm mapping the pipeline device IDs to the schematic's labeled components, starting with M1 as MPB1, whose drain sits on net1 at (152,154) with its gate on VB and its source on VDD. The netlist has most of its nets collapsed onto net1, so I'll need to rebuild the connections from the labels. Next is M2, MPA17, which has its drain at 154 going to net3 and its gate on B.

I'm working through how MPA17's gate ties into the MPA15 gate and the node that runs down toward MNA20, with a line from the MPA16 drain and a branch to the MPA17 gate.

Now I'm tracing the bias network: the RB1 bottom node, MNB2's drain, and the BN line feed the gates of MNB1, MNB3, and the MNA cascode devices. MNB2's source goes to MNB1's drain. On the PMOS side, MPB3 runs from VDD to the MPB4 source, with its gate tied to the BP line.

So the BP net is the gate of MPB3 and also sits on the MPB4 drain and the top of RB2. MPB4's gate is BPcas, which runs to the bottom of RB2 and the drain of MNB4. In the pipeline netlist, M5 and M8 both point at net7, so I need to split that out: M5's gate should be BP, which matches M8's drain and R2's positive end, while M8's gate should be BPcas, which matches R2's negative end and M15's drain.

I'm settling the BP and BPcas split: M5's gate and M8's drain go on BP with R2's positive end, while M8's gate, R2's negative end and M15's drain go on the new BPcas net. Then I'm moving on to which gates hang off BPcas and BP.

I'm checking the op-amp side now: the BP label should join net7, and the MPA11 and MPA13 drains each feed the source of their cascode partner. There's also a wire at about y=140 linking those nodes toward Vin-, and I'm tracing where the MNA11 and MNA12 drains run up into that same area.

I'm checking whether MPA12's source really belongs on net4 with MPA14's and the MPA11 and MPA13 drains, since the pipeline netlist merged them all there. The line near y=140 seems to join the two top drains, which would make them the tail of the PMOS pair, but the NMOS input pair's sources meet at the MNA14 drain, so that reading needs checking against the labels.

I'm checking whether the drains of MPA11 and MPA13 and the sources of MPA12 and MPA14 all land on one node, since the lines at x≈1043 and y≈140 seem to meet there. That would put the input-pair drains on the same net, though it looks odd for a cascode load, so I'll keep it as the working reading.

I'm checking the MPA12 drain next, which seems to run down the x≈1044 line toward the MNA16 drain, with a horizontal line at about y=408 that appears to reach the MNA21 gate area.

I'm checking how the NMOS cascode side hooks up now, with the bias gates feeding the tail and cascode devices. The gate of MNA21 seems to come down from the MPA12 and MNA16 drain node rather than from the BN line, which would make this a cascode current-mirror load, so I'll work through the connections on that basis.

I'm checking the NMOS cascode side: the node at y≈408 seems to tie the MPA12 and MNA16 drains to the gate of MNA15 and the drain of MNA18, which would make that junction the output of the cascode load rather than something on the BN line.

I'm checking where the y≈408 line runs, whether it reaches x≈1280 and joins the MPA14 and MNA18 drain node or only goes on to the MNA21 gate. The MNA17 and MNA19 gates seem to hang off the x≈1385 branch from that same junction.

I'm checking whether the y≈408 line actually reaches the x≈1280 vertical, since if it did, the MPA12 and MPA14 drains would end up on the same node, which doesn't make sense for this layout. The line probably just crosses over that vertical without connecting, so I'll treat node A as the MPA12 drain, the MNA16 drain, and the rest of that junction.

I'm checking the cascode devices in the NMOS section: MNA16's gate is on the bias line, and MNA15's gate sits on the same node as the MPA12 and MNA16 drains, which makes that cascode's wiring look unusual. I'll keep node B as the MPA14 drain, MNA18 drain, and the gates of MNA17 and MNA19, and go on to the output side.

I'm checking the NMOS cascode gates now: MNA17 and MNA19 both take their gate from node B, while MNA15 and MNA21 take theirs from node A, so the pipeline's net1 label for those gates is wrong.

I'm matching the PMOS right side to the netlist: the gate of MPA15 and the gate of MPA17 both sit on node C, which also joins the MPA16 drain and the MNA20 drain. M6's drain goes to MPA16's source, and its gate is node C too.

I'm confirming that the BPcas net runs through the gates of the PMOS cascode devices on both sides, including MPA16 and MPA18, and that the MPA12 and MPA14 gates hang off the same line. There's also a hop arc near (1610, 475–485) where the y≈484 line crosses something, which I still need to resolve.

I'm reconciling the remaining bias nets: the BPcas hop over the x≈1620 vertical is treated as unconnected, and BPcas feeds the MPA18 and MNA22 side. I'm also checking the PMOS gates on BP and noting that the MPA11 and MPA13 gate nets should merge with BP, which I'll carry forward as net7.

Now I'm checking the input pair: the Vin- gate sits at (640,366) on net10, and its drain goes to net4 while its source joins net11. The Vin+ device follows the same pattern, and both drains land on net4. Next I'm listing which pins belong on the BN net, starting with the gates of the bias devices.

I'm listing the nets around node P: the MPB1 drain, R1's positive end, and the BNcas gates on the NMOS cascodes, with the same net also reaching the M18 and M14 gates and the cascode devices further along.

I'm assigning the net names for the cascode and bias nodes, starting with the BN net for R1's negative end and the bias gates, then the A, B, and C nodes for the drains and gates, and finally the BPcas net for the PMOS cascode gates.

I'm going through the remaining net assignments: the BP net picks up the M5 gate, M8 drain, R2's positive end, and the M3 and M4 gates, and the M8 gate and the R2 negative end move onto the BPcas net along with M15's drain.

I'm reassigning the remaining devices to their nets: M9's gate moves to the bpc net, M17's drain goes to nC, and M19 and M20 drains go to nA and nB. The gates of M21, M23 and M27 land on bn, while M22 and M25 go to nB and M24 and M26 to nA. Last, M7 and M10 get their drains on nA and nB with gates on bpc, and M11's gate moves to bpc with its drain on nC.

Checking the net edits now: M7's drain on nA, M9 and M10 onto bpc, and M14's drain and R1's negative end on bn, with the M14 gate staying on the BNcas line.
